title: Rowan Bell · Community Manager · call with Celia Dove · May 2025
notice: Synthetic demo material. Invented document; no real meeting, publication, email or call occurred.

blocks.text: Spoke with Celia Dove about recent projects at the Eastfield allotments. She reported two items.

First, the seed swap bench. Celia set up a bench under the main shelter with donated envelopes, all labeled by crop and variety. She says it's become a regular weekend feature; people leave packets and take what they need. She keeps an eye on the stock but doesn't have to manage it closely.

Second, the rotation schedule. For the larger communal vegetable plots, Celia drew up a simple three-year planting rotation on a large sheet of brown paper. It's posted by the tool shed. She says several of the more established growers have started following it this season to help with soil health.
Both items are done and in use. No new requests or issues raised. Celia mentioned the waiting list for plots is steady; she's still managing it in her ledger.
